title: Why Leaves Change Color: Falling Leaves

scenes.title: THE LEAF LETS GO
scenes.caption: A separation layer forms at the stem.
scenes.narration: A layer of cells forms where the leaf joins its twig.

scenes.title: AUTUMN ON THE GROUND
scenes.caption: Leaves fall and cover the forest floor.
scenes.narration: When ready, the leaf separates and falls to the ground.

scenes.title: A CLOSER LOOK
scenes.caption: Each fallen leaf carries a seasonal record.
scenes.narration: Each fallen leaf records a season of growth and change.

scenes.title: WIND AND RAIN
scenes.caption: Weather helps move leaves from branches.
scenes.narration: Wind and rain help carry leaves from the branches.

scenes.title: A NATURAL RECYCLING LOOP
scenes.caption: Fallen leaves become part of the soil.
scenes.narration: Fungi and tiny animals break leaves down into soil.

scenes.title: THE FOREST FLOOR
scenes.caption: Decomposition feeds the next season.
scenes.narration: Those recycled nutrients help the forest grow again.
